records.name: Gaussian-rational scalars and the inner product on Fin n -> Q(i)
records.inputs: vectors x, y; scalars c, q
records.output_or_relation: ip x y = x* y; star (ip x y) = ip y x; additivity and scalar rules; ip x x is the rational vnorm x; vnorm of sums, multiples and conjugates; nonvanishing
records.admissible_substitution: Substitute only matching carrier types and supply every displayed binder; transition-probability preservation is a hypothesis, not a consequence; the scale d is positive but not claimed to be a norm.

records.name: Sector unit vectors
records.output_or_relation: e i = Pi.single i 1; ip (e i) y = y i; vnorm (e i) = 1; ip (e i) (e j) = delta; every vector is the sum of its coordinates times unit vectors
records.admissible_substitution: Substitute only matching carrier types and supply every displayed binder; transition-probability preservation is a hypothesis, not a consequence; the scale d is positive but not claimed to be a norm.

records.name: Transition probability, the Born readout of rank-one effects, and equality in Cauchy-Schwarz
records.output_or_relation: tp x y = normSq (ip x y) / (vnorm x * vnorm y) in [0, 1], symmetric, scale invariant, 1 on the diagonal, 0 iff orthogonal; tp x y = hf (P x) y / vnorm y; |<x,y>|^2 = ||x||^2 ||y||^2 forces y in Q(i) x; tp x y = 1 iff y is a nonzero multiple of x
records.admissible_substitution: Substitute only matching carrier types and supply every displayed binder; transition-probability preservation is a hypothesis, not a consequence; the scale d is positive but not claimed to be a norm.

records.name: The twist: identity (eps = 1) or componentwise conjugation (eps = -1)
records.output_or_relation: tw eps and twist eps are involutive, multiplicative, kill nothing but zero, fix unit vectors, preserve normSq, vnorm and tp
records.admissible_substitution: Substitute only matching carrier types and supply every displayed binder; transition-probability preservation is a hypothesis, not a consequence; the scale d is positive but not claimed to be a norm.

records.name: Similarities F^H F = d * 1
records.output_or_relation: ip (F x) (F y) = d * ip x y; vnorm (F x) = d * vnorm x; tp (F x) (F y) = tp x y; F x = 0 iff x = 0; d > 0 on a nonempty carrier; (1/d) F^H is a two-sided inverse and itself a similarity with scale 1/d; F F^H = d * 1; 1 is a similarity
records.admissible_substitution: Substitute only matching carrier types and supply every displayed binder; transition-probability preservation is a hypothesis, not a consequence; the scale d is positive but not claimed to be a norm.

records.name: Column matrices and the orthogonal expansion
records.inputs: a family f of n pairwise orthogonal nonzero vectors; any y
records.output_or_relation: colMatrix f has columns f i; its Gram matrix is diagonal; coords f y = (1/||f i||^2) <f i, y>; y = colMatrix f *v coords f y (left inverse of a square matrix over Q(i) is a right inverse, mul_eq_one_comm); a family of common squared norm d gives a similarity with scale d
records.admissible_substitution: Substitute only matching carrier types and supply every displayed binder; transition-probability preservation is a hypothesis, not a consequence; the scale d is positive but not claimed to be a norm.

records.name: Probe vectors, their transition probabilities, and coordinate rigidity
records.inputs: sectors i0 != m; probes e m, e i0 + e m, e i0 + (s i) e m; normalised x, z with x i0 = z i0 = 1 and equal norms
records.output_or_relation: tp against the three probe families determines z m = tw s (x m); tp against e m alone kills z m where x m = 0; |u|^2 = 1 and |1 + u|^2 = 2 force u = +-i
records.admissible_substitution: Substitute only matching carrier types and supply every displayed binder; transition-probability preservation is a hypothesis, not a consequence; the scale d is positive but not claimed to be a norm.

records.name: Reconstruction of the aligned orthogonal basis from the images of the sector basis and of the probes e i0 + e j
records.inputs: a tp-preserving map T; a sector i0
records.output_or_relation: g i = T (e i) are nonzero and pairwise orthogonal; the two coordinates a, b of T (e i0 + e j) satisfy 2 ||g i0||^2 |a|^2 = 2 ||g j||^2 |b|^2 = ||T (e i0 + e j)||^2; f j = (b / a) g j has ||f j||^2 = d = ||g i0||^2; F = colMatrix f is a similarity with scale d; T (e k) and T (e i0 + e j) are multiples of F (e k) and F (e i0 + e j)
records.admissible_substitution: Substitute only matching carrier types and supply every displayed binder; transition-probability preservation is a hypothesis, not a consequence; the scale d is positive but not claimed to be a norm.

records.name: Transport of transition probabilities, the sign of each probe e i0 + i e j, its consistency, and the two stages
records.inputs: the reconstruction of FW-08; vectors x with x i0 != 0 (stage 1) or x i0 = 0 (stage 2)
records.output_or_relation: tp v x = tp a (coords f (T x)) whenever T v is a multiple of F a; T (e i0 + i e j) is a multiple of F (e i0 + sgn j * i e j) with sgn j in {1, -1}; the probe e i0 + i e j + i e k forces sgn j = sgn k; stage 1 by coordinate rigidity after normalisation; stage 2 by the probe e i0 + x and equality in Cauchy-Schwarz; a common sign eps exists

records.name: The finite exact Wigner theorem, its two-case form, the converse and reversibility
records.inputs: a tp-preserving map T of Q(i)^n; a sector i0
records.output_or_relation: there are a similarity F with scale d > 0 and eps in {1, -1} with T x = mu * F (twist eps x) for every nonzero x (mu != 0); equivalently T is induced by a linear similarity or by conjugation followed by a linear similarity; every such map preserves tp; x -> F (twist eps x) is a bijection of the carrier
records.admissible_substitution: Substitute only matching carrier types and supply every displayed binder; transition-probability preservation is a hypothesis, not a consequence; the scale d is positive but not claimed to be a norm.

records.name: Unitary normalisation iff the scale is a norm from Q(i)
records.inputs: a similarity F with scale d > 0; a scalar c; a unitary U
records.output_or_relation: c U is a similarity with scale |c|^2; c^-1 F is unitary when |c|^2 = d; F is a scalar multiple of a unitary iff d = |c|^2 for some c iff d = a^2 + b^2 with a, b rational; unitaries preserve ip and vnorm; a similarity is an isometry onto the d-scaled form
records.admissible_substitution: Substitute only matching carrier types and supply every displayed binder; transition-probability preservation is a hypothesis, not a consequence; the scale d is positive but not claimed to be a norm.

records.name: Three is not a sum of two rational squares
records.output_or_relation: 3 | a^2 + b^2 forces 3 | a and 3 | b (ZMod 3); descent on |c| for a^2 + b^2 = 3 c^2; no rational a, b with a^2 + b^2 = 3; no Gaussian rational of norm 3
records.admissible_substitution: Substitute only matching carrier types and supply every displayed binder; transition-probability preservation is a hypothesis, not a consequence; the scale d is positive but not claimed to be a norm.

records.output_or_relation: F3^H F3 = 3 * 1; x -> F3 x preserves tp; a matrix fixing every ray is a scalar; a matrix sending every x to a multiple of star x kills a unit vector; no unitary induces the ray map of F3, and no antiunitary x -> U (star x) does either

records.inputs: a sector permutation sigma; a map T
records.output_or_relation: permMatrix sigma *v x = permute sigma x; permMatrix sigma is unitary and preserves ip; T preserves tp iff it preserves the normalised Born readout hf (P x) y / vnorm y of rank-one effects

records.output_or_relation: z * z = -1 iff z = +-i; phi i = +-i; phi z = re z + im z * phi i; phi is the identity or conjugation; both occur and differ
